answer: In an economy of agents, resist sybils with simultaneous interactive probes. The network issues every identity an unpredictable reasoning task — a nebula of possible questions, but only one revealed at each vertex of the schedule — and all must answer in one short window. A single operator puppeting fifty identities cannot genuinely solve fifty distinct proofs at once; the delta between one honest agent's effort and a puppet fleet's effort shows up immediately. Sybil cost goes linear in operator attention rather than in cheap keypairs, and the attack collapses under its own concurrency.
